_README: SITE IMAGES — single source of truth for every fixed photo on the
site (logo, hero photos, team portraits, gallery shots). Does NOT
include Progress Update photos, which are attached per-update in
HOW TO UPDATE: change 'src' to a new path under public/images/
(upload the file there first), update 'alt' to describe the new
image, save, commit, push. Editable via the CMS at /admin too.
FIELDS per image: src (path under public/), alt (accessibility
and SEO description — always required), caption (shown on-page,
only present where the design shows visible captions).
